project_name: Hiba Salim - MBA Portfolio & Case Study Management Studio
archetype: Swiss Editorial & High-Precision Product Studio (Architectural & Warm Clay Accents)

typography.heading_font: Outfit / Playfair Display (Serif/Display Hybrid with strong character)

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.caption: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-mono text-muted

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid for marketing & project showcase) + Mode B for Admin data analytics
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-lg for tags/inputs, rounded-full for pills

header.styles: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-neutral-900/80 border border-black/10 dark:border-white/10 shadow-sm z-50 sticky top-4 mx-auto max-w-7xl rounded-full px-6 py-3

hero_section.badge: PGPM Candidate @ Great Lakes · Ex-Footwear PM & Designer
hero_section.headline: Designer turned Product Manager, shaping Business Strategy & Marketing.
hero_section.subtext: 3 years building physical collections from concept to retail — now layering analytics, consulting frameworks, and GTM strategy to solve complex business problems.

card_interactive_features: Click card to open full Case Study Reader drawer/modal
Direct link buttons for External Live Prototype and PDF/Case Study
Admin Edit / Delete quick triggers when Admin Mode is unlocked

admin_editor_experience.description: Seamless, non-intrusive CRUD management interface for live project updates without complex backend requirements. Uses browser local storage + reset defaults.
features: Header toggle 'Admin Mode' with subtle passcode protection or instant unlock
Add New Project floating modal & inline row edit

Form fields for: Title, Subtitle/Summary, Category, Role, Tools (comma-separated), Year, Cover Image URL (with built-in unsplash search preset suggestions), Live Link, Case-Study Link, Detailed Problem Statement, Solution & Metrics
Local Storage persistence with 'Reset to Initial Data' safeguard button
Toast notification feedback using Sonner upon Save/Update/Delete

entries.organization: Great Lakes Institute of Management, Gurgaon
entries.details: Specializing in Marketing, Business Strategy, and Analytics. Participated in national case competitions and live industry projects.
Owned full lifecycle from concept sketch to manufacturing, vendor negotiation, line planning, and retail launch across seasonal collections.
Specialized in Footwear Design & Production technology, ergonomics, material science, and prototype testing.

resume_and_contact.resume_preview: Embedded interactive preview drawer with download options
resume_and_contact.contact_form: Interactive email composer form with data-testid attributes and instant feedback toast

motion_and_interactions.card_hover: scale-[1.015] -translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 ease-out shadow-lg shadow-black/5 border-brand_primary/30

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_standards: APCA 4.5:1 minimum on all body copy against warm sand / dark charcoal surfaces
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case data-testid on every interactive element (e.g., data-testid='nav-projects-link', data-testid='project-card-1', data-testid='admin-edit-project-button', data-testid='admin-save-project-btn')
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_nav: Full focus-visible ring outline on buttons, inputs, filter chips, and project cards

instructions_to_main_agent: Recreate Hiba Salim's MBA portfolio with high-precision Swiss-architectural visual aesthetics.
Implement the project editor/admin system with local storage persistence and full CRUD functionality (Add, Edit, Delete, Reset).
Use Lucide icons, Sonner toast notifications, and Motion for smooth interactive state transitions.
Ensure responsive support from mobile viewport (375px) to ultra-wide displays.
Tag all buttons, cards, modals, inputs, and filters with explicit data-testid attributes.
